notes: EPOCH 0 catalog. v1.2 (2026-08-12) amends O2 ONLY. v1/v1.1 credited O2 'First Write' from VaultMinted, but in the mint-on-fill model nothing mints when you WRITE — it mints when a BUYER FILLS you. 'First Write' therefore meant 'someone bought your option'. Measured on the live tape at amendment time: 124,369 OrderPosted vs 21 VaultMinted; 36 wallets held O1 and exactly 2 held O2. Because the onboarding chain is strictly sequential (D12), O2 also blocked O3 'Make a Market', so wallets that created a market AND wrote an option sat frozen at step 1. O2 now credits VaultDeposited OR OrderPosted(kind=WriterAsk). Per the 2026-08-12 ruling the qualifying write counts WHENEVER it occurred, not only at-or-after O1 — four wallets wrote 27-35 seconds before their first fill and would otherwise stay denied for exploring in an arbitrary order. Sequential AWARD ORDER is preserved by clamping the award timestamp to max(O1 completion, write time). Points, caps and every other quest are UNCHANGED. Unlike v1.1's amendment the retroactive delta is NOT zero and was dry-run and approved before going live.
